data.name: SunCarbon
data.description: SunCarbon is a biochar brand operated by Teo Ventures in India that converts agricultural biomass residues into biochar-based soil amendments, certified by ECOCERT India under NPOP/APEDA. Products are sold D2C (website, Amazon) and the company runs CDR project sites with farmer onboarding via its SunCarbon Saarthi platform.
